deck.caption:
Former Tata Technologies CEO McGoldrick just liquidated equity shares worth ₹165 crore in the open market.

Most retail investors view ex-executive share sales as simple routine wealth management or personal tax planning with zero structural impact on stock value.

Institutional reality? Massive insider cash-outs post-IPO are often peak valuation signals. Big players use retail buying liquidity to unload large positions right as hyper-growth begins to normalize.

Here is how to protect your capital:

• Track executive transaction size (>₹100 Crore is a major red flag)
• Audit promoter and anchor lock-in expiry schedules
• Demand fundamental value over brand halo

The Myth: Retail investors assume ex-CEO share sales are merely routine tax planning or personal wealth distribution with zero stock impact.

The Reality: Institutions view massive ₹165 Crore insider liquidations as peak valuation signals, using retail buying power as exit liquidity.

Core Rule: Retail buys narrative. Smart money trades valuation peaks.

slides.title: 3 Realities of Post-IPO Insider Sales

points.title: Peak Valuation Exit
points.desc: Insiders liquidate when valuation multiples far exceed long-term sustainable growth rates.

points.title: Retail Liquidity Trap
points.desc: Large blocks are dumped into open market order flow, transferring risk to retail buyers.

points.title: Growth Normalization
points.desc: Massive sales often precede earnings cycles where post-IPO growth rates begin to normalize.

slides.body_html:
1. Peak Valuation Exit: Insiders liquidate when valuation multiples far exceed long-term sustainable growth rates.

3. Growth Normalization: Massive sales often precede earnings cycles where post-IPO growth rates begin to normalize.

slides.title: 3 Rules Before Chasing Post-IPO Stocks
rules: **The ₹100 Crore Cap**: Avoid aggressive buying if executives liquidate over ₹100 crore post-IPO into retail order flow.
**Audit Lock-In Expiries**: Track anchor and promoter lock-in expiration dates to anticipate supply overhangs.
**Evaluate Earnings Yield**: Value company fundamentals over brand halo—don't pay peak multiples for slowing growth.
